name: fuzz_gap_reason
description: Why a surface of a fuzz target was not fuzzed. A gap is never clean.

definitions.no_harness: Tracked without a fuzzer: static-confirmed, or covered by another harness.
definitions.unsupported_language: No supported engine for the language.
definitions.needs_live_environment: Needs a cluster, cloud or network to exercise.
definitions.heavy_dependencies: The entry point needs dependencies too heavy to stub.
definitions.harness_defect: Crashers came from the harness, not the target, so the surface is untested.
definitions.build_failed: The harness did not build against the target.
